'''August 2004 Toronto tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Sunday 22 August 2004 at 401 Convenience, 401 Yonge Street, Toronto, Ontario, organized by [[Brandon Pahl]].<ref name="pcf-3824-52320">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52320#52320 Toronto, Ontario - August 22nd], Brandon Pahl (Mr. blp), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213115/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52320%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Registration opened at 11:00 am and the first game began at noon. It was a six-game constructed tournament with an unlimited card pool and a $10 entry fee, and decklists were mandatory. Pahl announced it as the first of a number of tournaments after [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire|Virtual Set 7]] that were to run until the New Year.<ref name="pcf-3824-52320" />

[[Spencer Ball]] wrote that the previous Toronto tournament had drawn 14 players.<ref name="pcf-3824-52585">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52585#52585 Toronto, Ontario - August 22nd], Spencer Ball (s_ skywalker), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213115/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52320%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Pahl bought a clock for the event so that there would be "no more 1.5 hour games".<ref name="pcf-3824-52628">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52628#52628 Toronto, Ontario - August 22nd], Brandon Pahl (Mr. blp), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213115/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52320%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' 401 Convenience, 401 Yonge Street, Toronto, Ontario<ref name="pcf-3824-52320" />
* '''Dates:''' 22 August 2004<ref name="pcf-3824-52320" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, unlimited card pool, six games; decklists mandatory<ref name="pcf-3824-52320" />
* '''Entry:''' $10<ref name="pcf-3824-52320" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Brandon Pahl]]<ref name="pcf-3824-52320" />
